entities.name: Đuro Gašparović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bishop Đuro Gašparović is a Roman Catholic prelate, Diocesan Bishop emeritus of the newly reestablished Diocese of Srijem in Serbia since 18 June 2008 until 14 February 2024. Previously he was a Titular Bishop of Mattiana and an Auxiliary Bishop of Djakovo or Bosna and Srijem in Croatia from 5 July 1996 until 18 June 2008.
